items.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio tx-gooey-morph, written here): Two words stacked. Over 1.5 s (linear fraction f 0 → 1): new word opacity f^0.4, blur min(8/f − 8, 100) px; old word the same with 1 − f. The pair goes through an alpha threshold (feColorMatrix alpha ×255 −140; demo: alpha < 130 → 0, > 150 → 255, linear between), so the blurred shapes merge like liquid. Cooldown 0.5 s between morphs. Demo: A → B 0.3–1.8 s, back 2.6–4.1 s (blur capped 18 px); loop 4.6 s. Params: morph: thời gian đổi (1.5 s) · cooldown: nghỉ giữa hai lần (0.5 s) · words: danh sách từ. Liquid look: the two blurred words pass through an alpha threshold (feColorMatrix alpha × 255 − 140).

items.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio catalog-kinetic-type-type-tunnel, written here): 4 copies of one word (34 px base) on a shared centre. Copy i has depth z = fract((i + 2t / 4.2) / 4): a copy enters every 2.1 s and crosses in 8.4 s. Scale = 0.3 × 22^z (0.3 → 6.6, exponential); opacity = min(1, 6z) × (1 − z)^1.8. While z < 0.4 the copy is filled accent; nearer copies are outline only (1.6 px on screen, opacity × 1.2). Draw far to near. Seamless loop (4.2 s demo). Params: số bản (4) · tỉ lệ (0.3 → 6.6) · chu kỳ (8.4 s mỗi bản) · chữ.

items.desc: Mỗi chữ cái là một khối hộp nhỏ lăn lên 90° nối nhau, mặt dưới mang chữ kiểu khác màu nhấn lật ra phía trước, rồi lăn về.

options.at: s each cube turns (0.55; 0.03 s apart, ≤ 0.6 s)
options.back: s they turn back (2.15)

items.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio tx-roll-flip-hover, written here): Each char is a cube as deep as its glyph box: front face = normal text; bottom face = same char in accent serif 700. On cue (0.55 s) each cube turns rotateX 0 → 90° about its centre (bottom face comes to the front) in 0.4 s power2.inOut, delay 30 ms × i (capped at 0.6 s total); front fades 1 → 0.3, new face 0.3 → 1 during the turn. Reverse from 2.15 s. Demo perspective 520 px at 46 px. Loop 3.4 s. Params: góc (0 → 90°) · thời gian (0.4 s) · cách nhau (30 ms) · kiểu chữ mặt sau (serif màu nhấn).

options.cursor: the cursor the tilt follows

items.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio tx-layered-depth, written here): 12 copies behind the headline: copy i offset by i × (0.55 + 3.2 × sin ry) px in x and i × (0.55 − 3.2 × sin rx) px in y, colour accent (every 4th copy second accent), opacity 0.95 (near) → 0.3 (far); front copy ink. Loop: fade 3.3–3.6 s, reset, fade in 3.8–4.1 s. Params: quãng lao (1.8 em) · thời gian lao (0.6 s) · quãng trượt (1.9 em) · độ bẹp (0.8 / 1.2).

Exit 3.75 s: fall, fade 3.85–4.25 s. Params: cách nhau (0.2 s) · độ nảy (0.4) · trọng lực (1500 px/s²) · độ nghiêng (±0.6 rad).

items.desc: Một quả bóng lăn vào đẩy chữ đầu, từng chữ cái đổ vào chữ kế tiếp như quân domino, chữ cuối ngã xuống sàn và nảy nhẹ.

options.ball: the ball that pushes the first letter

items.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio tx-domino-topple, written here): Spacing 0.42 em; pivot at each char's bottom-right. An accent ball rolls in to the first char 0.25–0.7 s (power1.in). From 0.7 s char j starts at j × 0.12 s (≤ 1.6 s total), falls power1.in in 0.12 s to its contact angle asin(gap / cap height) (≈35°), then leans on with the next char's progress to its final angle. Last char: 0 → 86° in 0.3 s power1.in, then dips ~7° and back (e^(−7t) |sin 14t|). Reset 3.45–3.95 s back.out. Loop 4.2 s. Params: giãn chữ (0.42 em) · cách nhau (0.12 s) · góc chữ cuối (86°).

items.sub: Ký tự đếm lùi về đúng chữ
items.desc: Mỗi ký tự bắt đầu lệch 10 bậc trong bảng chữ cái rồi đếm lùi từng bậc về đúng chữ, lần lượt từ trái sang.
items.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio tx-char-code-cycle, written here): Per char: shown char = target shifted forward k code points inside its class, wrapping (a–z, A–Z, 0–9, hiragana, katakana, CJK ideographs, fullwidth A–Z / a–z); k = ceil(10 × (1 − p_i)) (AE Character Offset 10 → 0); p_i = easeOutQuad over 1 s per char, chars staggered min(120 ms, 0.9 s/n) left → right from 0.4 s; integer steps, no fade; accent while k > 0. Demo loop: all ease back to +10 over 3.0–3.5 s (inQuad); loop 3.6 s. Mono font keeps widths. Params: offset: số bậc lệch ban đầu (10) · duration: mỗi ký tự (1 s) · stagger (0.12 s) · ease (easeOutQuad).

options.accent: flash of a revealed letter (0.14 s)

items.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio tx-placeholder-replace, written here): Each char starts covered by a solid block (█ U+2588; demo a rounded rect 0.84 × glyph width (min 0.32 em) × 0.8 em, muted; CSS inset 0.12 em 0.04 em, radius 2 px). From 0.45 s the blocks are replaced left → right, one per 40–90 ms (demo min(90 ms, 1.2 s/n)), instant swap (no fade); a freshly revealed char shows accent for 140 ms, then the text colour. Each card's reveal follows its position: from the viewport bottom to a line 84 px below the top it rises +20→0 px and fades 0→1 (outCubic over that 76 px of travel). items.desc: Giữ mỗi hình qua nhiều khung (12 hoặc 8 hình mỗi giây) để chuyển động có chất vẽ tay thay vì mượt tuyệt đối.

options.fps: drawings a second: 24 ones, 12 twos, 8 threes (12)

items.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio t-twos, written here): Keep the motion's own ease but hold each value on a fixed drawing rate: ones = 24 drawings/s (alternate 2 and 3 frames at 60 fps), twos = 12/s (hold 5 frames), threes = 8/s (alternate 7 and 8 frames). Site demo: three dots ping-pong 230 px (1 s each way, linear) sampled at 24 / 12 / 8 fps. Param fps (or a film-level cadence) snaps the progress to that grid. Params: cadence: ones | twos | threes (24 / 12 / 8 hình mỗi giây) · ease: giữ nguyên ease gốc. The motion keeps its own ease; only its progress is held on the drawing rate.

items.title: Snap, then Hold
items.sub: Bật tức thì rồi giữ yên
items.desc: Thay đổi xảy ra gần như trong một khung, chỉ phần lắng xuống có ease, rồi giữ yên để cảm giác chắc tay.

options.pop: scale it appears at, with no in-between frames (1.25)

items.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio t-snaphold, written here): Four stars, 450 ms apart: each appears at once at scale 1.25 (no in-between frames), holds 60 ms, settles 1.25 → 1 in 200 ms power2.out, then holds. Recipe: the change itself in 40–80 ms (1–2 frames), settle to 300 ms (expo.out), then hold. Params: pop (1.25) · snap (60 ms) · settle (0.2 s) · hold (≥ 0.6 s). The change itself takes 1–2 frames; only the settle is eased, then it holds still.

items.title: Beat Grid
items.sub: Lưới phách nhạc (BPM)
items.desc: Các chấm sáng lần lượt theo phách 120 BPM, phách mạnh đầu ô nhịp loé màu; đặt thay đổi lên phách, sự kiện lớn lên phách mạnh.
items.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio t-beat, written here): 120 BPM grid (beat 500 ms, bar 2000 ms; frames per beat = 60 / BPM × fps, 15 at 30 fps): four dots light in turn, the active one growing r 18 → 30 px and decaying as e^(−6·beat phase); the downbeat dot is accent and a 25 % accent full-frame flash decays as e^(−8·phase); a 16-step ruler playhead runs over the bar. Params: bpm (120) · beats_per_bar (4) · flash (25 %). Frames per beat = 60 / BPM × fps (15 at 30 fps): put changes on beats and big events on downbeats.

items.author: takayu
items.title: Speed Ramp into a Hit
items.sub: Dồn tốc chậm lại trước cú va
items.desc: Chuyển động chậm dần còn 25 % ngay trước cú va, đúng phách mạnh thì va, rồi tăng tốc trở lại.
items.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio t-ramp, written here): Recipe: over a 1200 ms move into a hit, speed 100 % until 300 ms before the impact, eased down to 25 % over those 300 ms, the impact frame on the downbeat, then back to 100 %. Site demo: rate 100 % until 0.8 s, linear ramp to 25 % over 500 ms, 50 ms at 25 % (impact), then 130 % at once; a dot integrates the rate (130 px/s at 100 %) with a 6-copy trail. As an ease / time-remap: ramp(slow 0.25, window 0.3 s, impact time). Params: slow (25 %) · window: đoạn chậm (0.3 s) · impact: lúc va (giây) · after (100 %). The dot integrates the rate, so a ramp is a time remap: slow into the hit, land it on the downbeat, then fast out.

items.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio t-overlap, written here): Three rows of 4 squares pop scale 0 → 1, 350 ms power2.out each; in each row the next starts at the previous start + 350 ms × (1 − overlap), for 0 / 25 / 50 % overlap. items.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio t-read, written here): Three short words cycle every 1330 ms: fade in 133 ms, hold, fade out 133 ms; a progress bar fills over each word and turns accent after 75 %. Rule: hold text at least max(0.70 s, 0.25 s + chars / 17), +0.25 s per word; even short phrases over 1 s. Recipe: enter 300 ms, hold, exit 200 ms. items.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio catalog-game-progress-quest-banner, written here): px @320x200. Accent band 48 px high opens from the centre 0 → 240 px wide in 500 ms outExpo at 0.3 s; the kicker is static, revealed by the band; the title fades in rising 6 px (450 ms outCubic, 0.45 s). Ribbon tails slide out 22 px behind the ends (300 ms back.out, 0.55 s). Underline grows from the centre to ±112 px, diamond ends (430 ms outExpo, 0.62 s); objective row fades up 6 px (350 ms, 0.95 s). Close 2.3 s: band height → 0 in 200 ms in-cubic. Params: width: bề rộng băng (240 px) · open: thời gian mở (0.5 s) · kicker / title: nhãn và tên nhiệm vụ · closeAt: lúc đóng (2.3 s). The band opens from the centre in 0.5 s (expo.out); tails slide out behind its ends (back.out), the underline grows with diamond ends.

items.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio tx-text-pressure, written here): A cursor sweeps left ↔ right across the line as a cosine every 4 s (amplitude half the line width + 14 px, small vertical bob). The number rides the bar's head; at 100 % bar and number turn green, a disc pops (back.out) and a tick draws.

items.author: takayu
items.title: Equalizer Bars
items.sub: Cột cân bằng âm nhảy, đỉnh rơi chậm
items.desc: Bảy cột âm thanh mọc từ đáy nhảy lên xuống mỗi cột một nhịp riêng, vạch đỉnh mỗi cột rơi xuống chậm hơn cột, lặp liền mạch.

options.fall: px a second² the peak caps fall (260)
options.loop: s (2.8): the bar waves repeat over it

items.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio catalog-ui-loading-equalizer-bars, written here): 7 bars 10 px wide r3, 18 px apart, anchored at the bottom. Height of bar i = 8 + 72 × (0.6 a + 0.4 b) × (0.55 + 0.45 sin(π (i + 0.5) / 7)), with a = 0.5 + 0.5 sin(2π (2 + i mod 3) t / 2.8 + 1.7 i), b = 0.5 + 0.5 sin(2π (1 + 2i mod 4) t / 2.8 + 0.9 i) (seamless 2.8 s loop). Peak cap: a 2 px line 4 px above max over the last 0.6 s of h(t − d) − 260 d². Params: bars (7 × 10 px, cách 18 px) · height (8-80 px) · loop (2.8 s) · peak fall (260 px/s²). Bar i: 8 + 72 (0.6 a + 0.4 b)(0.55 + 0.45 sin(π (i + 0.5) / 7)) with two sines of whole cycles per loop, so it loops seamlessly; the cap is the max of h(t − d) − 260 d² over the last 0.6 s.

items.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio ld-bar, written here): Track 220x8 r4, clipped. Params: period (1.8 s) · head / tail (lệch 0.4 chu kỳ) · ease (power2.inOut) · track (220x8). head = power2.inOut(clamp(1.4 p)), tail = power2.inOut(clamp(1.4 p − 0.4)); the bar spans tail → head, so it stretches and shrinks.

items.title: Combo Counter
items.sub: Đếm combo với thanh thời gian chờ
items.desc: Mỗi đòn trúng số combo nhảy lên một và phồng to, thanh chờ dưới số đầy lại rồi cạn dần; quá thời gian chờ thì combo đứt: số xám đi, tụt xuống, nhỏ lại và mờ, kèm nhãn "đứt chuỗi".
items.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio catalog-game-combat-combo-counter, written here): px @320x200. Hits at 0.35, 0.70, 1.05, 1.40 s: number (46 px, accent) steps +1 with scale 1.4 → 1 in 250 ms outCubic; grace bar 80 x 6 refills in 60 ms outCubic (light ink for 100 ms, then accent) and drains linearly over 900 ms. When empty (2.36 s) the combo breaks over 340 ms: number greys, drops 10 px, shrinks 15 %, fades; 'broken' label in. Per hit: hitter flash 120 ms, squash 12 % (scaleX 1.12 / Y 0.88, 250 ms half-sine), 7-dot burst to 18 px. Params: hits: lúc trúng (0.35 / 0.70 / 1.05 / 1.40 s) · grace: thời gian chờ (0.9 s) · pop: cỡ vọt (1.4) · gauge: thanh chờ (80 x 6 px). The 80 × 6 gauge refills in 60 ms on each hit and drains linearly; when it empties the combo greys, drops 10 px, shrinks 15 % and fades over 340 ms.

Spot: same outline at 2.2 px with a diagonal yellow → accent → blue gradient and a 14 px accent glow, seen through a radial mask r 62 px (≈19 % of width; 1 → 0.8 at 55 % → 0) on a scripted cursor (enters 2.0 s, crosses to 3.8 s, exits 4.3 s); spot in 1.6–2.0 s, out 3.9–4.3 s. Fade 4.45–4.9 s. Loop 5 s. Params: thời gian vẽ (2.2 s) · bán kính đốm (62 px) · nét viền (1.1 / 2.2 px). Apply to an SVG text drawn as an outline (fill none). A glowing gradient copy of the outline shows only inside a soft round mask that follows the pointer.

items.author: takayu
items.title: Pointer Reveal Card
items.sub: Thẻ chữ lộ mặt sau theo con trỏ
items.desc: Trên một thẻ, con trỏ kéo qua đến đâu thì chữ mặt trước bị thay bằng chữ mặt sau màu nhấn đến đó, rời thẻ thì vạch chia trượt về mép trái.

options.back: the back layer (same size, on top of the front)
options.follow: s the divider takes to follow (0.4, power2.out)
options.scan: px between scanlines on the back (30)

items.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio tx-pointer-reveal-card, written here): Card 276 × 118 px, radius 10; front text (ink) and back text (accent), 44 px, same centre. Divider x follows the cursor x inside the card (else the left edge) with a 0.4 s power2.out response. Right of it the front text; left the back text plus faint accent scanlines every 6 px (6 %). Divider 1.5 px accent with a 6 × 20 px handle. Cursor enters left 0.85 s, sweeps to the right edge by 2.1 s, nudges 3.0 s, leaves 3.35 s (divider returns in 0.4 s). Loop 4.4 s. Params: chữ mặt trước / mặt sau · thời gian trả về (0.4 s) · vạch chia (1.5 px). Left of the divider shows the back text with faint accent scanlines, right of it the front; outside the card the divider returns to the left edge.

items.author: takayu
items.title: Cursor Bulge Lens
items.sub: Thấu kính phồng, phóng to chữ
items.desc: Một vùng tròn dưới con trỏ phồng lên như giọt nước, phóng to và bẻ cong phần chữ bên dưới, có bóng đổ và vệt sáng, trượt dọc theo dòng chữ.

options.pop: s the lens swells or settles (0.35, power2.inOut)

items.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio tx-lens-bulge, written here): Demo (2D): text 68 px over a 10 px dot grid; a round lens r 50 px follows a scripted cursor (enters 0.35–1.0 s at 15 % into the text, slides to 15 % from its end by 2.6 s, exits 3.3 s). Ring r inside is magnified 1 + a × easeInOutCubic(1 − r/50) (40 rings), a 0 → 0.9 with a 0.35 s power2.inOut response; soft shadow offset (5, 7) px at 0.5, highlight 12 %, 1 px accent rim 45 %. Recipe (WebGL): 100 × 100 plane, r 3 units, z += easeInOutCubic(1 − d/3) × 1.0. Params: bán kính (50 px) · độ phóng giữa (×1.9) · thời gian bật (0.35 s). 2D: forty rings inside the lens, each drawing the scene magnified 1 + a × ease-in-out cubic(1 − r / radius), with a soft shadow, a highlight and a thin accent rim.

items.author: takayu
items.title: SFX Cues on the Grid
items.sub: Đặt tiếng động đúng phách
items.desc: Mỗi tiếng click, pop, thump, whoosh được đặt đúng khung đỉnh của chuyển động hoặc đúng phách đo được.sfx`.
items.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio sd-cues, written here): Each motion's peak frame = the sound's onset (within +-1 frame; the kit puts the attack one frame after the picture). Demo: a 4 s beat ruler with cues click 0.5 s, pop 1.0, thump 2.0, whoosh 2.75, pop 3.5; at each cue a ring pulses 8 -> 28 px decaying e^(-8 t) (motion 120 ms easeOutExpo). Params: sounds (click / pop / thump / whoosh) · at: phách hoặc đỉnh. Each motion's peak frame is the sound's onset (within ±1 frame). In a Moworks film, write these as the app's sfx cues; this block only shows where they land.

items.author: takayu
items.title: Audio Bars
items.sub: Cột âm thanh nhảy theo nhạc
items.desc: Mỗi cột là một dải tần, nhảy lên nhanh và rơi chậm hơn, cột trầm to và chậm, cột cao nhỏ và nhanh.
items.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio sd-bars, written here): Bars per frequency band: rise ~100 ms ease-out, decay over 300-500 ms; bass big and slow, treble small and fast. Demo: 24 bars (7 px, 11 px pitch, max 120 px): v = (1 - f) x 0.7 x e^(-5 x beat phase) + noise(t x (3 + 10 f)) x 0.4 x (0.3 + f), a beat every 0.5 s, the 6 lowest bars in the accent. Params: bars (24) · rise (0.1 s) · fall (0.3–0.5 s). v = (1 − f) 0.7 e^(−5 · beat phase) + noise(t (3 + 10 f)) 0.4 (0.3 + f): bass big and slow on the beat, treble small and fast.

items.author: takayu
items.title: Sidechain Duck
items.sub: Nhún nền theo tiếng trống
items.desc: Mỗi tiếng trống kick, chuyển động nền khựng lại một chút rồi hồi về chậm như sidechain trong nhạc.
items.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio sd-duck, written here): On each kick the ambient motion (camera, background) dips: attack ~3 frames (100 ms), release 24-36 frames (800-1200 ms). Demo: every 0.5 s the duck rises linearly over 25 ms then decays e^(-12 t); background scale 1 - 0.08 x duck while the foreground dot grows 20 -> 30 px. Params: amount (−8 %) · attack (0.1 s) · release (0.8–1.2 s). Like a sidechain compressor: on each kick the ambient motion dips fast and recovers slowly.

options.times: s each word is spoken (word timestamps)
options.lead: s the pop comes before the word (0.3; 0.2–0.6)
options.spoken: s a word lasts on the waveform (0.55)
options.wave: waveform bars that light as words are heard (optional)

items.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio sd-lyric, written here): Each word appears over 250 ms back.out (scale 0 -> 1), starting 0.2-0.6 s before it is spoken (word-level timestamps). Demo: 4 words at 0.3 / 1.1 / 2.0 / 2.9 s, the third in the accent, over a waveform that lights while each word is heard. Params: duration (0.25 s, back.out) · lead: sớm hơn lời (0.2–0.6 s). Take the times from the voice clip's word timestamps.
